mechanism: Meclizine may potentiate the hypoglycemic effect of glimepiride through additive CNS depression and reduced glucose awareness, while glimepiride metabolism may be affected by meclizine's anticholinergic properties.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely; patient should be educated on hypoglycemia recognition, as meclizine may mask symptoms through anticholinergic and CNS effects; consider dose adjustment if needed.
